title: A module never imports a sibling module (leaf domains stay independent)
intent: Both absolute (``from app.modules.tasks...``) and relative (``from ..tasks...``) sibling imports are caught — a relative import is resolved to its absolute module first, so renaming the import style does not re-couple two leaf modules.

runtime.rationale: Module independence is an import-graph property of the source tree. At runtime the composed app legitimately holds every module in one process, so a cross-module reference is indistinguishable from composition itself.
